title: 18mm Male Ground Glass Hose adapter
description:
Another item that will make your life just that little bit easier should you need to connect a whip to an 18mm female glass joint.
This adapter has an 18mm male glass connection on one side and a connection for your whip/hose on the other.
Another item that can come in handy when using these type of adapters is sick clips. These help keep connections together while in use.
Included
1 x 18mm Male Whip Adapter
